newsitem.title: USA: U.S. says sees no Iraqi troops going north.
newsitem.headline: U.S. says sees no Iraqi troops going north.

text.p: The United States sees no evidence that elite Iraqi Republican Guard forces are moving north for fresh fighting as a Kurdish group has claimed, defense officials said on Thursday.
"There is no movement. We do not see it," one said.
He said there was no sign that Republican Guard units were moving out of their garrisons around Baghdad.

The Kurdish rebel group that has been supported by Iran, the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), said in a statement issued in Paris that Iraqi Republican Guards were moving northward from the Baghdad area "in preparation for imminent, hostile, offensive action against the Kurdish provinces of Arbil and Sulaymaniyah."

Massoud Barzani, leader of the rival Kurdish Democratic Party (KDP) that has been supported by Iraq, told a news conference near the northern Iraqi town of Salahuddin that he might ask Baghdad for help in his feud with the PUK.
